scenarios.name: Switch customization targets by keyboard with an edit pending

scenario_steps.name: a part is active in the MCAD Software
the Ribbon customization dialog shows All Commands and an empty Part Tools target
the Part Manage target is empty
the user double-clicks "2D Sketches" in the available list
the user opens the custom panel target selector
the user presses Down and Enter to select Part Manage
the Part Manage custom panel list is empty
"2D Sketches" is available in the source list
the user opens the custom panel target selector
the user presses Up and Enter to select Part Tools
the Part Tools target has a pending-change marker
"2D Sketches" appears in the custom panel list
no User Commands panel is visible on the Tools ribbon
